quest.title: Victory Banquet
quest.description: Go to the site of the Victory Feast with Kokomi and listen to her speech.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x450, Mora x31125, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

chapter.title: Warriors' Dreams Like Spring Grass Renewing

talks.objective: Go to the site of the Victory Feast

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: It looks like everything's in place for the feast. But I still need to give a quick speech before the festivities begin.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... How much energy will that take? D'you think you've got enough?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I've got plenty. Thanks to you two, I recovered more quickly than usual.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's great! We'll be rooting for you!

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Welcome everyone. Today is the day that we celebrate our victory.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Recently, our war with the Shogun's Army came to an end, and we finally saw the abolition of the Vision Hunt Decree.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: None of us can know what the Inazuma of the future will look like. But tomorrow, I meet with the Tenryou Commission for peace talks. I give you my word that I will strive for peace for Watatsumi Island, once and for all.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Thank you all for your valiant efforts throughout. Truly, it is only through those efforts that we have been able to prevail in this trying war.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: This feast is held in honor of each and every one of you gathered here today. I hope all of you get to relax and enjoy our hard-won victory.

dialogues.speaker: Watatsumi Islanders
dialogues.text: Woohoo!!!

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Tonight seems to have gone off without a hitch. I'm so glad it's all going smoothly.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: #People tend to be more open when they're in a good mood. Could I ask you to go around and see what information you can gather, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: I still have no further leads regarding the issue of potential collusion between the Tenryou Commission and the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: And I'm concerned that something might happen at tomorrow's peace talks...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, sure. We'll go ask around.

dialogues.speaker: Arisawa
dialogues.text: A friend of mine was really looking forward to this feast. Even promised he'd sing a song with me. *sigh* If only he were still here...

dialogues.speaker: Matsuda
dialogues.text: With me around, no one would dare try any funny business at the Victory Feast!

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: You're a strong fighter... No wonder Her Excellency chose you.

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: You really do have a warrior's will... Then, maybe you can understand us.

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: Captain, comrade... will you join us?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: First you need to tell me what's going on.

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: We made it up. The story about the Tenryou Commission colluding with the Fatui... It didn't happen.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: WHAT!? Poor Kokomi's been worried sick! You're telling us you made the whole thing up?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What the heck were you thinking? This could send you right back into war with the Tenryou Commission!

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: Yes. That's exactly what we're hoping to achieve.

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: Peace talks? Pfft... Everyone's been drawn in by the idea. That's why the future of Watatsumi Island is at stake.

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: What's to stop the Tenryou Commission from stabbing us in the back? And what's to stop the Raiden Shogun from issuing another Vision Hunt Decree?

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: We are the resistance! Everything hinges on our warrior's will!

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: We can't trust the Tenryou Commission or the Raiden Shogun. But we can put faith in ourselves!

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: Surely you agree with that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: His point does kinda make sense, but something about it doesn't feel right to Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What it boils down to is... you just want to fight.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! Everything you said just now was pure speculation, wasn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you seriously willing to make up a wild rumor and ruin the peace everyone's worked so hard for, all because of some imaginary situation that may not even happen?

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: Don't take that tone with me, acting like you're above all of this! What would you understand?

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: For the sake of victory, we embodied the warrior's will to the fullest. You understand? We were all in. Now they're suddenly trying to tell us that none of it matters anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: You'd have me just put down my weapon and start living like an ordinary person, but how can I? How can I, when... when every time I close my eyes, I see the faces of the friends we lost in battle.

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: Every time I see them there, in my mind's eye, it reminds me that I can never forgive the Tenryou Commission, and never forgive the Vision Hunt Decree!

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: I guess you're not one of us... Well, whatever. Go ahead and tell Sangonomiya if you want. But you're too late to stop us now...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Too late? What do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Darn, doesn't seem like he's gonna answer that one.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #What are we gonna do, {NICKNAME}? This is really serious! We need to give Kokomi the full story right away!

dialogues.speaker: Hirai
dialogues.text: Watatsumi Island is finally at peace, and it's all thanks to Her Excellency, Sangonomiya...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's new? Anything to report?

dialogues.speaker: Hirai
dialogues.text: Recently? Um, lemme think...

dialogues.speaker: Hirai
dialogues.text: Well, the biggest thing for us is that we can finally get back out on the ocean to fish.

dialogues.speaker: Hirai
dialogues.text: During the hostilities, the open sea was full of warships. We just had to make do with what little fish and shrimp we could get our hands on closer to shore.

dialogues.speaker: Hirai
dialogues.text: When the catch wasn't good, we'd all go hungry. The poor kids were crying all day and night, but there was just nothing I could do.

dialogues.speaker: Hirai
dialogues.text: We'd go to bed ravenous and be tossing and turning all night long, trying to keep it together until the morning. At least things are finally improving now...

dialogues.speaker: Hirai
dialogues.text: I hear you're Captain of Swordfish II, is that right? Well, thank you for your service. Here, have a fish! It's freshly caught, so it's a bit, uh, fishy, but it's fine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... no, no, no, w—we couldn't possibly...

dialogues.speaker: Hirai
dialogues.text: Ah, come on, take it! Without you, we'd probably still be going to bed hungry tonight. Her Excellency always teaches us to repay kindness with gratitude.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Okay, well, thanks. Come on, {NICKNAME} let's go talk to some others.

dialogues.speaker: Kabasawa
dialogues.text: Hey there, care for some fresh fruit and vegetables? Nature's remedy when you overdo the barbecue!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's new? Anything to report?

dialogues.speaker: Kabasawa
dialogues.text: Are you referring to the thing about the Tenryou Commission and the Fatui? I've heard rumors, but nothing too detailed.

dialogues.speaker: Kabasawa
dialogues.text: It's funny you should say that the soldiers seem excitable, though. I've had the same feeling. See that guy over there?

dialogues.speaker: Kabasawa
dialogues.text: He's been acting strange these days — always shouting and waving his spear around when he's got nothing to do. He's scared the heck out of me a few times.

dialogues.speaker: Kabasawa
dialogues.text: Ugh... It's a miracle the fighting has finally come to an end. I really hope we don't go making any more trouble for ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Kabasawa
dialogues.text: Sorry, I'm afraid I don't have much information. If you still have questions, you may as well go and talk to him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Sounds promising. Let's go see what that guy's deal is, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew... this guy smells of booze...

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: Mm? Wait, wait, don't tell me... Captain of Swordfish II! Right?

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: You actually came back. I thought you'd abandoned the platoon and made a run for it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nuh-uh! We would never run from a fight!

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: Hmph, is that so. All anyone talks about these days is peace and stability.

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: Do you remember what the most important thing is to the resistance?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A warrior's will.

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: You got that right. So I'm gonna put you to the test. Time to see if you truly are a bona fide resistance warrior.

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: I'll answer your questions — but only if you can beat me in a duel.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, this guy... Would it kill him to just have a normal conversation...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #What do you think, are we gonna do this, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Sure. We're hardly going to lose.
In a few seconds you'll be begging to talk!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...So we found out a few things.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The whole thing about the Tenryou Commission colluding with the Fatui is baloney! They made it all up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They wanted the peace talks to break down so that they could carry on fighting the war. And they said that it's too late to try and stop them, no matter what we do.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Mm. I see.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: This is my fault. If only I'd perceived what they were feeling earlier, it never would have come to this.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: I think I understand what Kouzen means when he says it's too late.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: The talks don't begin until tomorrow, but both sides have already sent their guards to the location. They are responsible for making sure the area is safe and secure.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: I highly suspect that one of Kouzen's pro-war co-conspirators will have infiltrated the guards with an intent to reignite hostilities tomorrow during the negotiations.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well that's no good. Do you want us to head over there now and switch out the guards?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: That won't work. Firstly, the act of bringing a new team of guards to a neutral negotiation site will put both sides on high alert.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: It would almost certainly push the pro-war faction into taking action. They would attack the Tenryou Commission's guards, and we'd be in danger of war breaking out once again.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Not to mention that we have no idea how many of Watatsumi Island's soldiers are involved in this plot. If we change the guard in haste, we face the issue of not knowing who to trust.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds like a really tricky situation... so, is there really nothing we can do about it?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Don't let it worry you, what's done is done. Mm... Now it falls to me to devise a counter plan.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: These soldiers crossed a line, but the blame is not theirs alone. Whatever happens, I will find a way to ensure they do not come to harm...

talks.objective: Report the truth back to Kokomi

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Found anything out yet?

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: I'm not drunk... Another one's not gonna do me any harm! Haha!

dialogues.speaker: Youkou
dialogues.text: Her Excellency is looking much better today, I can breathe a sigh of relief... Nothing is more important than everyone being safe and sound.

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: I do hope the future will be free from the trials and tribulations of the past. If every day can be as happy as today, that would be a blessing.

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: Come visit Watatsumi Island whenever you want. You'll always be a hero here!

dialogues.speaker: Hirai
dialogues.text: Let's hope the peace talks go smoothly. The last thing we want is to go back to war...

dialogues.speaker: Kabasawa
dialogues.text: So much fighting... we could all do with a rest. Hey, anybody need some fruit or vegetables? Get them today, they're on sale.

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: That all you got? I expected more from Swordfish II.

dialogues.speaker: Kouzen
dialogues.text: Come on! Again!
